# Learning note — One useful question

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD

Use an ignored local note by default; publish only a deliberately edited lesson.

- What did I expect?
- What actually happened? Point to the relevant code or evidence.
- Why did it happen? Separate evidence from hypothesis.
- What would I do differently next time?
- Is there one reusable improvement to propose to this repository's method?

Optional exercise: predict a failing case, write/run the smallest check, then explain the result in your own words.
